lines.text: Hello, Jasper! It’s tea time at the top of the tree.
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Hello! It’s tea time at the top of the tree.
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: I’ve baked pop biscuits! They go pop in your mouth.
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: Oh dear, oh dear! My whistling kettle! It’s GONE!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: Gone? Where did you leave it?
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: Eh? Up my SLEEVE? No, I’ve looked up there!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: Not your sleeve! Where did you LEAVE it?
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Oh! On the top branch. Tap its lid, and it whistles a tune!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: Listen! That’s your kettle. It’s up in the cloud!
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: A new land has come! But this cloud is too thick to see it.
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Can you blow the cloud away, Jasper? Tap it!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Can you blow the cloud away? Tap it!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Just tap the cloud. Whoosh!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: I’ll puff it away with a little spell.
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: Whoosh! It’s gone! Thank you, Jasper!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Whoosh! It’s gone! Thank you!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Oh no. It’s Dame Snap’s School!
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: Snap’s POOL? Lovely! I’ll go for a swim!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: That’s my kettle! I’d know that whistle anywhere!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: In we go. Quiet as mice, everyone.
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: THERE IT IS! MY KETTLE!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: Shh! Not so loud!
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: Then, from inside the school… clack. Clack. CLACK.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: WHO is shouting in MY school?
lines.speaker: dameSnap

lines.text: That kettle WHISTLED! NOBODY whistles in my school!
lines.speaker: dameSnap

lines.text: Eh? No WHISKERS? But I’ve got lovely whiskers!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: NO whistling! NO kettles! And NO FUN!
lines.speaker: dameSnap

lines.text: She hates whistling. So let’s give her a really big one!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Can you tap the kettle’s lid, Jasper? Make it whistle!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Can you tap the kettle’s lid? Make it whistle!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Tap the little lid on top.
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: I’ll tap it myself. Ting!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: STOP that WHISTLING!
lines.speaker: dameSnap

lines.text: My RULER! Oh, BOTHER and BOTHER!
lines.speaker: dameSnap

lines.text: You did it! What a whistle!
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: What a whistle! She’s gone!
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: My kettle! Hello, old friend!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: The land is moving on! Back to the ladder!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Home safe, and just in time for tea!
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: Pop biscuits for everyone. And one for Jasper!
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: Pop biscuits for everyone. And one for you!
lines.speaker: silky

lines.text: Thank you, Jasper! You saved my kettle!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: Thank you! You saved my kettle!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: Who would like a cup of tea?
lines.speaker: moonface

lines.text: A cup of BEES? No thank you! They buzz!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: Oh! TEA! Yes please!
lines.speaker: saucepan

lines.text: And the kettle whistled all the way through tea.
lines.speaker: narrator
